answer: The main driver of the customer churn spike in Q3 2025 was the SMB segment, which was the largest contributor with churned customers increasing from 4.0 in Q2 to 25.0 in Q3 (accounting for 25.0 out of the total 67.0 churned customers in Q3, or a share of change of 43.75%). For the SMB segment, what was normal before was a range of 4.0 to 8.0 in the earlier periods from 2024-Q3 to 2025-Q2. The other segments also moved higher comparably: Mid-Market churned customers increased from 11.0 in Q2 to 31.0 in Q3 (accounting for a 41.67% share of change), while Enterprise churned customers rose from 4.0 to 11.0 (accounting for a 14.58% share of change).
